title: [Mouse Without Borders] Impossible to run without elevated privileges, Impossible to change layout
summary: The elevation warning is clear, but the report does not establish why PowerToys remains elevated after the setting is disabled.

judgment.rationale: A fix cannot be scoped until the team can distinguish a stale elevated process, an installation policy, and a Mouse Without Borders-specific elevation path.
evidence: The layout editor reports that PowerToys is elevated even after the reporter disables the run-as-administrator setting.
No bug report ZIP or process elevation details were attached.
The report does not say whether PowerToys was fully exited and restarted after changing the elevation setting.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current bug report and precise elevation/restart observations.

comment.body: Please fully exit PowerToys from the tray, confirm no PowerToys processes remain in Task Manager, restart it with `Run as administrator` disabled, and check whether Task Manager still shows PowerToys as elevated. If the layout remains locked, attach a newly generated PowerToys bug report ZIP and tell us whether PowerToys is installed per-user or machine-wide, whether it starts with Windows, and whether any compatibility setting or enterprise policy forces it to run elevated.
